authority_standard: CIBRC / DPPQS / TNAU / ICAR-IIRR / IRRI Standard (2024-2026)

chemicals.target: Stem borer (Scirpophaga incertulas), Leaf folder (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis)
Brown planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens), Green leafhopper (Nephotettix virescens)
warnings: Direct spray strictly to base of tillers

chemicals.target: Green leafhopper (GLH vector of Tungro), Brown planthopper, Thrips
warnings: Neonicotinoid foliar spray; observe 21-day PHI

chemicals.target: Rice thrips (Stenchaetothrips biformis), Green leafhopper, Gall midge, Stem borer
Stem borer, Gall midge, Whorl maggot
warnings: Class Ib high toxicity carbamate pesticide
Subject to state-level bans/restrictions (e.g. banned in Kerala; restricted in Tamil Nadu)
Severe avian, aquatic, and groundwater leaching hazard
NOT recommended as first-line farmer action; safer CIBRC-registered diamides/neonicotinoids must be used

chemicals.target: Earhead bug (Leptocorisa acuta)
warnings: Direct panicle application during grain milking carries severe grain residue (MRL) hazard
Mandatory minimum Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) of 7-10 days must be strictly enforced before harvest
Do NOT spray within 7 days of harvest
Controlled advisory only with mandatory PHI warning; botanical Azadirachtin preferred for late milking

chemicals.target: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae), Bacterial Leaf Streak, False Smut
warnings: Non-antibiotic inorganic copper bactericide; gold-standard alternative to restricted agricultural antibiotics
Do NOT apply during open anthesis/flowering (9:00 to 11:30 AM) to avoid floret sterility

chemicals.target: Rice blast (Magnaporthe oryzae - leaf blast & rotten neck blast)
chemicals.dose: 500 g/ha (0.6 g/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Gold standard systemic blasticide; highly effective at 50% boot leaf stage

chemicals.target: Rice blast
chemicals.dose: 750 ml/ha (1.5 ml/L water) in 500 L water

chemicals.target: Sheath blight (Rhizoctonia solani), Sheath rot
chemicals.dose: 1000 ml/ha (2 ml/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Direct spray to plant base and lower sheaths

chemicals.target: Sheath blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
chemicals.dose: 1000 ml/ha (2 ml/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Microbial antibiotic fungicide derived from Streptomyces hygroscopicus; safe to spiders and beneficial fauna

chemicals.target: Sheath blight, Rice blast
chemicals.dose: 500 ml/ha (1 ml/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Broad-spectrum dual systemic combination

chemicals.target: Sheath rot (Sarocladium oryzae), False smut (Ustilaginoidea virens), Brown spot
chemicals.dose: 500 ml/ha (1 ml/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: For False Smut: Must be sprayed strictly at 50% boot leaf stage prior to panicle emergence
Never spray during open flowering (anthesis)

chemicals.target: Bacterial Leaf Blight, Bacterial Leaf Streak
chemicals.dose: 100 g + 500 g per hectare in 500 L water
warnings: Agricultural antibiotic formulation subject to Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) regulatory restrictions in Indian agriculture
Streptomycin + Tetracycline combinations are phased down under CIBRC/MoAFW directives to prevent clinical resistance spillover
NOT recommended as first-line farmer action; Copper Hydroxide 77 WP is the certified non-antibiotic recommendation
Retained as historical/monitored recommendation with mandatory AMR alert

chemicals.target: Leaf folder (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis)
warnings: Ryanodine receptor modulator; rapid larval feeding cessation

chemicals.target: Gall midge (Orseolia oryzae), Whorl maggot (Hydrellia philippina), Stem borer
warnings: Phenylpyrazole systemic insecticide; apply within 15-30 DAT

chemicals.target: Brown planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens)
warnings: Selective chordotonal organ feeding blocker; highly safe to mirid predators and spiders

chemicals.target: Leaf folder, Earhead bug, Thrips, Green leafhopper
warnings: Botanical antifeedant; zero residue hazard; ideal for late milking stage of earhead bug

chemicals.target: Brown planthopper (BPH)
warnings: PROHIBITED FOR BROWN PLANTHOPPER (BPH)
Synthetic pyrethroid application causes catastrophic pest resurgence by decimating natural predators (Lycosa spiders, Cyrtorhinus mirid bugs)
Must NEVER be recommended or prescribed for BPH

chemicals.target: Brown planthopper (BPH)
warnings: PROHIBITED FOR BROWN PLANTHOPPER (BPH)
Synthetic pyrethroids trigger explosive hopper resurgence and rapid hopper burn
Must NEVER be recommended for BPH

chemicals.target: Rice blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
warnings: Agricultural microbial antibiotic fungicide derived from Streptomyces kasugaensis; CIBRC registered on rice

chemicals.target: Brown spot (Bipolaris oryzae)
chemicals.dose: 1000 g/ha (2 g/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Broad-spectrum contact dithiocarbamate fungicide; spray at early tillering and booting

chemicals.target: Brown spot, Sheath rot
chemicals.dose: 750 g/ha (1.5 g/L water) in 500 L water
warnings: Dual-action systemic (Carbendazim) and contact (Mancozeb) formulation

chemicals.target: Sheath rot (Sarocladium oryzae), Brown spot seed treatment
chemicals.dose: 500 g/ha (1 g/L water) or 2 g/kg seed
warnings: Systemic benzimidazole fungicide; effective seed treatment against seed-borne inoculum

chemicals.target: Bacterial Leaf Blight, Bacterial Leaf Streak
warnings: Inorganic copper contact bactericide/fungicide

chemicals.target: Sheath blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
warnings: SDHI systemic fungicide; highly active against Rhizoctonia
